thread:
lara: Quick tidy: we have inconsistent param names across snippets (`model` vs `model_name`) and some pages use "latency" loosely. Proposing we standardize public SDK examples to `model` and use "response latency" for end-to-end metrics.

gavin: +1 to `model` in SDKs. Shorter and aligns with our client impls. Keep `model_name` in DB/schema docs.
yasmin: I can update examples and the Observability guide. Small ask: add a one-line glossary entry explaining the decision and a short style note: "Use concise, neutral phrasing."
docs-bot: New PR by gavin: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4899 - "examples: unify model param"
gavin: PR updates JS/Py snippets and adds a comment: `# legacy schemas may use model_name` instead of saying deprecated. Also added a tiny docs-lint that flags mixed param usage.
yasmin: Nice. I'll change any ambiguous "latency" -> "response latency" where applicable and review the customer-facing wording.
lara: Let's avoid using "deprecated" in examples — reserve that for formal deprecations. Also add a changelog line for traceability.
gavin: Done. CI passed. Merging once yasmin gives a quick copy pass.
yasmin: LGTM, merging now.
docs-bot: PR merged by gavin at 2460789046
lara: Thanks all. Adding a checklist item: "confirm SDK param parity across examples before merge" to docs style checklist.
